title: BLS powers-of-tau k37k: leaf reduction at a capped cumulative share (s37, H7) on k37i

claims.statement: For the protected BLS12-381 powers-of-tau target, the complete paired class-walk algorithm and argument supplied here has W(2^20)<=2^115.893848570516577 reference units at C=2000 and success>=0.39 conditional on explicitly disclosed H1-H5 in source-proof.md and H7 (proof.md s37) with H4 restated as the per-class floors of proof.md section 30 (pair fraction F=998/1000 and leaf share 193/200, both checked per class before any group operation). It uses only A_1 and A_(2^20); the same W(n) bound holds for 2^20<=n<r. All preprocessing, failure, transport and recovery work included. Total memory<2^122.0004 bytes, preprocessing<2^114.9031 units and included, no advice. Analytical conditional bound. s32: the batch forward pass stores e = v2 - x1 once per lane op; every kernel forms X = V + e and tests bit 383 (kernels 923/587 derived from s1's measured 929 listing, executed); BATCH 29411/32. s33: gap tables built by pair levels at the s26 pair price. s31: table beta keys (138 per giant point), N_b=ceil(23 N_g/20). Baby point 3616427285067/3276800000, giant point 4226321685067/3276800000 instructions. s37: leaf X >= p lanes counted, cumulative share capped at 7/32 per barrier (charged 582.1875).

experiments.purpose: Recompute the amended ledger and exact log ceiling; rerun the s30 planner floors, the toy curve recovery (x-keys, three giant lookups, 23/20), transport simulation, census, the s32 kernel and leaf kernel audits (plain and P+T: paths, lanes, footprint), the s31 table beta_keys with reduction and build, the executed batch round with e and both side calls (also as a table level), the K1 witness and the record-path audits. toy class-length spread (H2), structured-lane X >= p share (H7). Finite evidence only.
